items.detailedArticle:
Overview of SSC CHSL Tier 1 Exam City Slip 2026

The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has officially published the advance exam city intimation slip for the Combined Higher Secondary (10+2) Level Examination (CHSL) 2026 Tier 1 test. Candidates who applied for the recruitment of Lower Division Clerk (LDC), Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA), and Data Entry Operator (DEO) positions can now access their login portals to check the city allocated for their upcoming computer-based test (CBT).

The city intimation slip acts as an advance notification to help candidates plan their travel arrangements, accommodation, and logistical requirements prior to the release of the final hall ticket. The main admit card containing precise venue addresses and exact reporting times will be issued approximately three to four days before individual exam dates.

Key Highlights of the SSC CHSL Notification

  • Recruiting Agency: Staff Selection Commission (SSC)
  • Post Name: LDC, JSA, DEO Grade 'A'
  • Exam Phase: Tier 1 Computer Based Examination
  • City Slip Release Date: 26 November 2026
  • Official Website: ssc.gov.in

Eligibility Criteria and Post Details

Applicants for SSC CHSL 2026 must fulfill specific minimum criteria set by the commission:

  • Educational Qualification: Candidates must have passed 12th Standard or equivalent examination from a recognized Board or University. For DEO Grade 'A' positions in specific departments, passing 12th in Science stream with Mathematics is mandatory.
  • Age Limit: General category candidates must be between 18 and 27 years of age. Standard upper age relaxations apply for reserved categories, including 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, and up to 10 years for PwD candidates.

Selection Process

The SSC CHSL recruitment procedure comprises two major competitive phases, followed by mandatory document verification and medical fitness checks:

  • Tier 1 Examination: Objective type Computer Based Test featuring General Intelligence, Quantitative Aptitude, English Language, and General Awareness sections.
  • Tier 2 Examination: Comprehensive multi-module exam assessing mathematical abilities, reasoning, language proficiency, computer knowledge, and skill/typing tests.
  • Document Verification: Final verification of original academic records, caste certificates, and identity proof conducted by user departments.

Step-by-Step Guide to Download Exam City Intimation Slip

  1. Visit the official website of Staff Selection Commission at ssc.gov.in.
  2. Navigate to the login section on the homepage and enter your Registration Number and Password.
  3. Click on the 'Candidate Dashboard' tab and select the link titled 'SSC CHSL Tier 1 Exam City Intimation Slip 2026'.
  4. Your exam date, reporting shift, and assigned examination city will be displayed on the screen.
  5. Download the document and keep a printed copy for reference while planning travel.

Exam Preparation Tips

With the exam city notification out, candidates should maximize their final revision window effectively. Focus on solving official mock tests and previous year question papers to build speed and accuracy under strict time constraints. Review core mathematical formulas, high-yield grammar rules, and current affairs updates from the preceding six months to maximize score efficiency.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1. Is the exam city intimation slip the same as the SSC CHSL Admit Card?

No, the exam city slip only informs candidates about their exam date and city location. The actual admit card with the venue address and roll number will be released separately a few days prior to the test date.

2. What details are mentioned in the city intimation slip?

The slip contains the candidate's name, application number, assigned exam city, state, reporting time, and exact exam date.

3. Can I request a change in my allotted examination city?

No, the commission does not entertain requests for changing the allotted exam center or city under any circumstances.

4. What documents are required to enter the examination center?

On exam day, candidates must present their original printed Admit Card along with a valid government photo ID (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Passport, Driving License) and recent passport-size photographs.

The State Bank of India (SBI) has officially released the recruitment notification for the position of Junior Associates (Customer Support & Sales), commonly known as Clerks, for the year 2026. Aspirants preparing for banking exams in India have a massive opportunity this year, with a total of 1,540 vacancies announced across various branches nationwide. SBI Junior Associate recruitment is widely considered one of the most prestigious gateway opportunities for graduates aspiring to build a stable and rewarding career in the public banking sector.

If you are planning to appear for this competitive examination, understanding the registration timelines, eligibility requirements, selection criteria, and application protocols is crucial. This comprehensive guide provides all the essential details you need to navigate the SBI Junior Associates Recruitment 2026 successfully.

Detailed Overview of SBI Junior Associates Recruitment 2026

SBI conducts the Junior Associate recruitment drive annually to fill clerical cadres in its branches across different states and Union Territories. The 2026 recruitment notification brings 1,540 lucrative posts, opening doors for eligible young graduates who possess strong aptitude, logical reasoning, English proficiency, and basic computer knowledge.

Working as an SBI Clerk offers lucrative salary structures, dynamic career growth, and immense job security. Because of these perks, lakhs of candidates apply for this examination every year. To secure a seat among the 1,540 selected candidates, aspirants must prepare strategically and stay updated with every phase of the recruitment lifecycle, right from online registration to the final merit list.

Key Highlights of SBI Clerk 2026 Recruitment

  • Conducting Body: State Bank of India (SBI)
  • Post Name: Junior Associates (Customer Support & Sales / Clerical Cadre)
  • Total Vacancies: 1,540 Posts
  • Application Start Date: 26 November 2026
  • Job Location: Across India (State-wise postings)
  • Official Website: sbi.co.in/careers or bank.sbi/careers

Eligibility Criteria & Selection Process

Before filling out the online application form, candidates must carefully verify whether they fulfill the eligibility criteria set by the State Bank of India.

  • Educational Qualification: Candidates must hold a Graduation degree in any discipline from a recognized University or any equivalent qualification recognized as such by the Central Government. Final-year graduation students may also apply provisionally, provided they produce proof of passing graduation on or before the specified eligibility date.
  • Age Limit: Generally, candidates must be between 20 and 28 years of age. Age relaxation in the upper age limit is applicable for candidates belonging to reserved categories (SC, ST, OBC, PwD, and Ex-Servicemen) as per Government of India guidelines.
  • Language Proficiency: Candidates applying for vacancies in a particular state must read, write, speak, and understand the specified regional language of that state. A local language test may be conducted as part of the selection process.

Selection Process: The selection for SBI Junior Associates 2026 comprises a rigorous two-tier examination process followed by language proficiency verification:

  • Preliminary Examination: An online objective test consisting of three sections—English Language, Numerical Ability, and Reasoning Ability. The exam carries a total of 100 marks with a sectional time duration of 20 minutes for each section.
  • Main Examination: Candidates who clear the Prelims cut-off are eligible to appear for the Mains exam. The Mains syllabus covers General/Financial Awareness, General English, Quantitative Aptitude, and Reasoning Ability & Computer Aptitude.
  • Test of Specified Local Language: Provisional selection is subject to the successful clearance of the local language test for candidates who have not studied the regional language in their 10th or 12th standard.

Step-by-Step How to Apply and Download Notifications

Applying online for the SBI Junior Associates 2026 recruitment requires precision. Follow these step-by-step instructions to complete your registration smoothly:

  • Step 1: Visit Official Website: Go to the official SBI careers portal at sbi.co.in/careers.
  • Step 2: Access Recruitment Link: Navigate to the "Current Openings" section and click on the link titled "Recruitment of Junior Associates (Customer Support & Sales)".
  • Step 3: New Registration: Click on "Apply Online" and register yourself by entering your basic contact details like name, email ID, and mobile number. A provisional registration number and password will be generated and sent to your registered email/phone.
  • Step 4: Fill Application Form: Log in using your credentials and fill in your personal, academic, and professional details carefully. Select your preferred exam centers for Prelims and Mains.
  • Step 5: Upload Documents: Upload scanned copies of your photograph, signature, left-hand thumb impression, and a handwritten declaration as per the prescribed SBI dimension and file size guidelines.
  • Step 6: Pay Examination Fee: Pay the required application fee online through Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI. (SC/ST/PwD/XS candidates are generally exempted from fee payment).
  • Step 7: Final Submission & Printout: Submit the application form and download/print a copy of the final submitted application form and e-receipt for future reference.

Document Preparation Tips for SBI Junior Associate Application

To avoid technical rejections during the online application process, keep the following scanned documents ready in advance:

  • Scanned Photograph: Recent passport-size color photograph against a light background (Dimensions: 200 x 230 pixels, size between 20KB to 50KB in JPEG format).
  • Scanned Signature: Signed clearly on white paper with black ink (Dimensions: 140 x 60 pixels, size between 10KB to 20KB in JPEG format).
  • Thumb Impression: Left-hand thumb impression scanned on white paper with black or blue ink (File size between 20KB to 50KB).
  • Handwritten Declaration: Written in English on white paper using black ink stating text provided in the official notification (File size between 50KB to 100KB). Ensure the text is written by the candidate and not in capital letters.
  • Academic Certificates: Mark sheets and degree certificates of 10th, 12th, and Graduation to correctly fill percentage and roll numbers.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1. What is the total number of vacancies announced for SBI Junior Associates 2026?

SBI has announced a total of 1,540 vacancies for the Junior Associates (Clerical Cadre) recruitment drive across various states and union territories in India.

2. When does the online application window open for SBI Clerk 2026?

The online registration process officially commences on 26 November 2026. Aspirants must submit their forms before the closing date mentioned in the official notification.

3. What is the minimum educational qualification required to apply?

Candidates must possess a Graduation degree in any discipline from a recognized university. Final year graduation students are also eligible to apply provisionally.

4. Is there any negative marking in the SBI Junior Associates online examination?

Yes, there is a negative marking of 1/4th (0.25) of the marks assigned to a question for every incorrect answer marked in both the Preliminary and Main examinations.

5. How can I download the official SBI Junior Associates 2026 notification PDF?

You can download the official notification PDF directly by visiting the official SBI careers website under the 'Current Openings' tab, where detailed guidelines, state-wise vacancies, and exam schedules are published.
